technique_name: Given an English sentence, correctly identify all the parts of speech in the sentence. Output the words and its part of speech (Noun, Verb, Adjective, Adverb, Conjunction, etc) one by one and seperate
description: She - Pronoun, always - Adverb, ran - Verb, quickly - Adverb, to - Preposition, the - Article, store - Noun.
example: She always ran quickly to the store.
